text: ok so my foster son he 9 and he been running hot all evening, 39 on the thermometer just now. I'm tired as hell but something ain't sitting right. He got these little dark dots coming up on his legs and a couple on his belly, like somebody poked him with a pen tip, and one bigger spot look like a bruise but he ain't hit nothing. I did the glass thing they always be telling you to do, pressed it right on there and them dots still showing plain as day, ain't go nowhere. Other than that he grumpy cause he ain't been to the bathroom for a number two in like 3 days lol he big mad about that. Just tell me what I need to be doing
